author: FlexAir5
quote:
i wanted to love this game. I really did. since last year, i worked side jobs for five months on and off, just to afford a PS5 for the game, and I still had to borrow money from friends to actually buy the game. I took a whole week off work to play it, using every bit of paid leave I’d saved up all year. That’s how much I was looking forward to this.

And after all that, the game was not what I expected. Not even close.
The game feels different in all the wrong ways.  the missions feel like a chore instead of something fun. What I played did not feel like the gta I waited thirteen years for. The world may look pretty, but actually playing it was bad, frustrating, sluggish, and just not enjoyable. I kept forcing myself to keep going because of how much I’d spent and how much time I’d taken off, but I ended up more disappointed than entertained. add that up with the fact that i needed to pay back the money i owe my friend. (we live in a country where the game cost like half of our minimum wage).

Maybe some people will love it, but for me, this was a huge letdown after sacrificing everything, including the 5 days paid leave that I wish I could get back
